criteria.text: Acute treatment of diagnosed migraine with or without aura
Patient is at least 18 years old
Prescribed by or in consultation with a headache specialist, pain specialist, or neurologist
Provider has ruled out medication overuse as a cause of migraines
Trialed at least 1 prophylactic medication for at least 2 months
Trialed 2 different triptans or has a contraindication to their use
Patient agrees not to drive or operate machinery until at least 8 hours after a dose

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Reyvow (lasmiditan) Criteria Version 1; Original 09/30/2020; Approval 11/20/2020; Effective 2021-01-11. Serotonin 5-HT1F receptor agonist (ditan).
Closed indication: acute treatment of migraine with or without aura in adults; not indicated for preventive treatment of migraine.

Prior prophylactic therapy examples include beta blockers, antiepileptics and antidepressants. At least one medication must have been trialed for at least 2 months. Two different triptans must have been trialed, or triptans must be contraindicated (e.g. cardiovascular). Trials do not require separately documented failure; shared fact keys retain the failed naming convention.
The patient agreement not to drive or operate machinery until at least 8 hours after taking a dose is a required attestation.
Denial: failure to meet approval criteria only.

Cautions (notes only): no more than one dose in 24 hours; CNS depression, with caution in combination with alcohol or other CNS depressants; serotonin syndrome has occurred, discontinue if symptoms occur; not recommended in severe hepatic impairment; based on animal data, may cause fetal harm.
Duration (notes only): initial approval up to 3 months; reauthorization approval up to 12 months.
Quantity limits (notes only): 50mg tablets, 8 per 30 days; 100mg tablets, 8 per 30 days. max_units is null; quantity enforcement requires manual review.

Remains partial: diagnosis, specialty consultation, medication overuse exclusion, therapy trials and driving agreement use attestations. Evidence verification, cautions, duration, reauthorization and quantity require manual review. PDL status unknown.
